allocations.rationale: Extracts patient-level numerators, denominators, and HPO terms from the primary discovery cohort (Birnbaum et al. 2024), directly addressing question 1 and negative findings.
Resolves the direct contradiction between Turkyilmaz et al. and Birnbaum et al. concerning syndromic versus nonsyndromic classification, short stature penetrance, and speech impairment.
